source_clause: NEWPR7.2) Avatars will be sorted into at least 3 categories. Pushing a category button will show the respective grouping of avatars. Categories apply to all screen sizes, 7" will have a separate screen for category selection, an example is pictured above.
leaf_desc_037: NEWPR7.2) Avatars will be sorted into at least 3 categories. Pushing a category button will show the respective grouping of avatars. Categories apply to all screen sizes, 7" will have a separate screen for category selection, an example is pictured above.
reasoning: 驗證目標：8.8.2（NEWPR7.2）—— avatar 至少分為 3 類，按下分類按鈕顯示該類之 avatar。關鍵情境條件：螢幕尺寸取 8.4 吋以上（分類與清單同畫面）。為什麼這樣切：數目與作用為同一句之兩個斷言，§5.7 併於一條。

tcs.tc_title: Avatars are sorted into at least three categories
tcs.test_item:
Avatars are sorted into at least three categories

(Verifies that avatars are sorted into at least three categories and that a category button shows its own group)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A New Profile Setup is at the avatar step
2. The vehicle screen is 8.4 inches or larger
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the avatar screen and count the category buttons
2. Press one category button
3. Read the list and check which avatars are shown
tcs.expected_result:
1. At least three category buttons are offered
2. The category button is pressed
3. Only the avatars of that category are shown
tcs.priority_basis: avatar 之分類數與分類按鈕之作用
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **ER3 不可省** —— 只驗分類按鈕之數目，一個**按了沒反應**之實作會通過；條文明說`Pushing a category button will show the respective grouping`。**7 吋之獨立分類畫面未涵蓋**：條文寫 `7" will have a separate screen for category selection`，而 037 未為其另切 leaf —— 本條取 8.4 吋以上一側，**為抽樣，7 吋之分類畫面不由本條保證**。
